title: Pleiades TV — VOD streaming with subscriptions, comments, likes, and sharing

requirements.text: Create the Pleiades TV app shell with a coherent, distinctive visual theme (colors, typography, spacing, and component styling) applied consistently across all pages. Use English for all user-facing text.

quotes: Build an app named Pleiades TV that allows users to watch videos on-demand, subscribe, comment, like and share

acceptanceCriteria: App name “Pleiades TV” is visible in the UI (e.g., header).
Theme is applied consistently (buttons, inputs, cards, typography).
All UI strings are in English.

requirements.text: Implement Internet Identity authentication so users can sign in/out and the app can associate subscriptions, comments, and likes with a unique user identity.
acceptanceCriteria: User can sign in with Internet Identity and sign out.
UI clearly indicates signed-in vs signed-out state.
Authenticated principal is available to the rest of the app for gated actions (subscribe/comment/like).

requirements.text: Add backend data models and APIs to support a video catalog and video detail retrieval (at minimum: video id, title, description, thumbnail image URL, video playback URL, duration/created timestamp). Seed the app with a small default catalog so the UI works end-to-end without manual setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes query methods to list videos and fetch a single video by id.
At least 3 sample videos are returned from the list endpoint after deployment.
Each video includes a playback URL that the frontend can use in a standard HTML5 video player.

requirements.text: Build VOD browsing and playback UI: a home/browse page that lists videos (thumbnail + title) and a video detail page that plays the selected video on-demand with title/description and engagement controls.
acceptanceCriteria: Home page renders a grid/list of videos from the backend.
Clicking a video navigates to a detail view.
Detail view plays the video using the stored playback URL.
Loading and error states are shown for video fetches.

requirements.text: Implement subscriptions: users can subscribe/unsubscribe to Pleiades TV (global subscription) and view their subscription status. Enforce that only subscribed users can access video playback while allowing non-subscribed users to browse the catalog and see video detail metadata.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend stores per-user subscription status and exposes methods to get status and toggle subscribe/unsubscribe.
Frontend shows a clear “Subscribe/Unsubscribe” control and current status.
Non-subscribed users can browse the catalog but attempting to play a video is blocked with a clear call-to-action to subscribe.
Subscribed users can play videos successfully.

requirements.text: Implement video comments: authenticated users can post comments on a video and view a comment list on the video detail page (include author identifier display and timestamp).
acceptanceCriteria: Backend supports adding a comment to a video and listing comments for a video in chronological order.
Frontend shows existing comments on the video detail page.
Signed-in users can submit a comment; signed-out users are prompted to sign in to comment.
Newly posted comments appear in the UI without a full page refresh.

requirements.text: Implement video likes: authenticated users can like/unlike a video and see the like count on the video detail page (and optionally on the browse cards). Likes must be one per user per video.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend enforces at most one like per user per video and exposes like count + user’s like state.
Frontend displays like count and current user like state.
Toggling like updates the UI immediately and remains correct after refresh.

requirements.text: Enable sharing: provide a share action on the video detail page that allows users to copy a shareable URL for the current video to the clipboard (and, when available, trigger the browser’s native share sheet via Web Share API).
acceptanceCriteria: Video detail page has a Share action.
Copy-to-clipboard produces a shareable URL that includes the video id.
If Web Share API is supported, the app can invoke it; otherwise it gracefully falls back to copy-to-clipboard.
User receives visible feedback after copying/sharing.

requirements.text: Add a simple account/subscription page where an authenticated user can see their principal (or a short form) and subscription status, and can manage subscribe/unsubscribe from there as well.
acceptanceCriteria: Account page is reachable from navigation when signed in.
Account page displays user identity info and subscription status.
Subscription can be managed from the account page.

requirements.text: Add generated static image assets for branding and placeholders, and render them in the UI (store under frontend/public/assets/generated).

quotes: Build an app named Pleiades TV...

acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist under frontend/public/assets/generated.
App uses the generated logo in the header/login area and uses placeholders where appropriate (e.g., missing thumbnails/avatars).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in the main actor file.

Do not edit files under frontend immutable paths (frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui); compose them from new code instead.
No external databases or third-party auth providers; use Internet Identity for authentication.
nonGoals: Implementing live streaming or real-time chat.
Processing payments for subscriptions (subscription is an in-app state, not billing).
Uploading videos from users or building an admin CMS UI (seed catalog only).
Integrating external social media APIs for sharing (use URL copy / Web Share only).

required: Wide header/hero background illustration with abstract star-cluster motif (pleiades-hero.dim_1600x400.png)
